DOCKET NO. 55378

IN RE:  	Georgia Power Company’s 2023 integrated resource plan update


Order Approving first dco agreement 


The Georgia Public Service Commission (“Commission”) in the Order Adopting Stipulation in Docket No. 55378 (“2023 IRP Update Final Order”) regarding Georgia Power Company’s (“Georgia Power” or “Company”) 2023 Integrated Resource Plan (“IRP”) Update, approved with modifications the Distributed Energy Resources (“DER”) Customer Owned (“DCO”) Program implemented through the DER Customer Owned Tariff (“DCO-1”). 
Through the DCO-1 tariff, Georgia Power will operate and control customer-owned, new dispatchable DER located at customer premises and economically dispatch the resources to provide energy and capacity benefits to all customers. Under this program, Georgia Power will provide participating customers with a credit on their electric bills in exchange for the Company’s use of the customer’s DER for economic dispatch. The credit will be based on the capacity and energy value of the participating customers’ DER over the period during which they subscribe to the DCO Program. 
Georgia Power and the Atlanta Falcons Football Club, LLC have executed the first DCO Agreement for the Atlanta Falcons Training Camp, the effectiveness of which is subject to the Commission’s approval. In a February 19, 2026 filing which included both public disclosure and trade secret copies of the agreement, the Company requested that the DCO Agreement be deemed certified because the resource is customer-owned and participates in a program approved by the Commission in the 2023 IRP Update Final Order. Consistent with other DER Program offerings, the DCO credit for this agreement was calculated at 75% of the levelized net present value of the customer’s DER to the system over the contract period. The total capacity value of this agreement is 1,280 kilowatts (“kW”).
After review of the Company’s filing and DCO Agreement, Staff recommended that the  DCO Agreement between Georgia Power and the Atlanta Falcons Football Club, LLC be deemed certified.
The Commission approved Staff’s recommendation at the March 3, 2026 Administrative Session. 

* * * * * * * * * * * * *


WHEREFORE IT IS ORDERED that the DCO agreement between Georgia Power Company and the Atlanta Falcons Football Club, LLC included in Georgia Power Company’s February 19, 2026 filing is hereby deemed certified.
ORDERED FURTHER, that all findings, conclusions, statements, and directives made by the Commission and contained in the foregoing sections of this Order are hereby adopted as findings of fact, conclusions of law, statements of regulatory policy, and orders of this Commission.
ORDERED FURTHER, that a motion for reconsideration, rehearing, or oral argument or any other motion shall not stay the effective date of this Order, unless otherwise ordered by the Commission.
ORDERED FURTHER, that jurisdiction over this matter is expressly retained for the purpose of entering such further Order or Orders as this Commission may deem just and proper.
The above by action of the Commission in Administrative Session on the 3rd day of March 2026.
